user.title: Teleco Automation account
user.description: Log in with the account of your brand app (Daisy Teleco, Biossun, Brustor, Durmi, Gibus, Hardtop, Kettal, Pratic, Wise).

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: This account has several installations (boxes). Pick the one to add; add the integration again for the others.

data_description.transport: Auto sends commands to the box on the local network and falls back to the cloud.
data_description.local_host: Leave empty to use the address the box reports to the cloud.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the state is read from the cloud.

travel.title: Cover travel times
travel.description: Covers only open, stop and close. With the time a full opening and a full closing take, Home Assistant can also set a position by timing the move. Measure them with a stopwatch or `teleco cover calibrate`. Set 0 to remove them.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded to list its covers.
abort.no_covers: This installation has no cover that could use travel times.
